task: Build the entire demo in the three supplied placeholder files. Create a clean, self-contained Three.js + Vite browser scene with a large flat ground plane and a basic procedural car made only from Three.js primitive geometry (no external models, textures, images, or assets). Make the car clearly read as a car: body, cabin, four wheels, sensible proportions. Make it drivable with WASD and arrow keys using simple arcade-style acceleration, braking/reverse, steering, damping, and wheel rotation; add a smooth third-person chase camera. Add restrained lighting, shadows, sky/background and subtle ground/grid cues so motion and scale are readable while the world remains fundamentally a flat plane. Keep the implementation compact, performant, responsive, and usable on desktop. IMPORTANT MANIFEST CONTRACT: package.json must be syntactically valid strict JSON, with double-quoted property names and string values, no comments, no trailing commas, and no JavaScript syntax. It must define exactly these dependency entries: dependencies.three = "0.185.1" and devDependencies.vite = "8.2.2". scripts.build must be exactly "vite build"; scripts.dev may be exactly "vite"; scripts.preview may be exactly "vite preview"; define no other scripts or dependencies. Before returning your diff, mentally parse package.json as JSON and correct any syntax error. index.html must be the full page entry point. src/main.js must contain the Three.js implementation. Do not add or reference any other project files. OUTPUT CONTRACT: return only one canonical git-style unified diff modifying exactly package.json, index.html, and src/main.js. No Markdown fences, prose, commentary, renames, new files, or deleted files.
